evidence.reason: The finding asserts that line 579 uses a prototype-chain lookup (`actEnvs[name]`) and line 584 uses `name in expEnvs`, letting live environments named after Object.prototype keys evade the unlisted-environment drift line. The current tip already contains the proposed own-property checks at both sites: line 579 reads `Object.hasOwn(actEnvs, name) ? actEnvs[name] : undefined` and line 584 reads `!Object.hasOwn(expEnvs, name)`. This matches the supplied history entry f7bc9a726568a6bd685ab7eca644ea12972e3366 ("own-property env checks"), so the defect is remediated at the pinned tip.
